result.title: ShiftGuard: Evaluating Confidence and Feature Distance for Risk-Controlled Image Classification
result.summary: A classifier that is usually right still makes confident mistakes, and a deployed system needs some way to decide when to answer and when to abstain. Cheap post-hoc scores such as maximum softmax probability (MSP) and predictive entropy are the standard answer. Distances in feature space are a popular alternative, and fusing several signals into one score is a natural next step. We ask whether adding a feature distance signal to MSP and entropy improves error detection, and whether it increases the share of predictions that can be accepted at a certified error rate when only a small labelled calibration set is available. We train a CIFAR-adapted ResNet-18 from scratch on CIFAR-10 (92.92% test accuracy, one seed) and compare five reliability scores: MSP, entropy, distance to the predicted-class centroid, a logistic fusion of MSP and entropy, and a logistic fusion of all three signals. Acceptance thresholds are chosen on a held out calibration set with Clopper Pearson upper bounds, Bonferroni corrected over a prespecified family of 315 rules at 95% simultaneous confidence. Confidence based scores were best. Error AUROC was 0.9230 for MSP, 0.9233 for entropy and 0.9235 for MSP plus entropy, against 0.8814 for the three signal fusion and 0.8224 for distance alone. At a 5% risk target with 1,000 calibration images, entropy accepted 84.82% of test images with 2.05% observed error, while three signal fusion accepted 80.61% with 2.21%. With 250 calibration images, neither distance nor the three-signal fusion could certify the 5% target at all. The results come from one seed, one dataset and one architecture, with no corruption experiments, so they say nothing about distribution shift detection. Within these limits, the distance signal did not earn its added complexity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 CIFAR-10 上比较 MSP、熵、特征到预测类质心距离及两种 logistic 融合分数，用 Clopper-Pearson 上界在小校准集上设定接受阈值，考察风险受控下的错误检出与接受比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时回答、何时弃权」的校准式风险控制可为 LVR 的 STOP 决策阈值设计提供参照，特征距离信号无增益的负结果也提示需核查 latent 相似度类置信信号是否只是表面有效性；但材料限于单模态单种子，需较多核查。
